captureScope: Read-only per-window cua-driver capture, user explicitly authorised inspecting iTerm. Private shell captures retained only in ignored artifacts, not published.
limits: Colours/geometry are sampled measurements, not whole-window similarity or complete UI parity. Shell startup content is not copied or simulated; font fallback differs across operating systems.

profileColours.method: Appearance-only values read from the installed iTerm profile; separate from sampled screenshot colours. No command/environment imported.
